memory_contract.length_error_contract: Error 90 may leave the output-length slot untouched. Read it only if a UINT64_MAX sentinel was overwritten. An insufficient legacy receive buffer may already have consumed the event; event_poll_v1 retains its pinned event on capacity90.

authority_contract: All ROS resources start without authority. Opening an alias uses an explicit trusted grant; SDK factories, codecs and node objects grant no rights.
rules: No implicit grants, retry, native callbacks, process/shell/socket escape or host native ROS client
Application callbacks consume bounded event_poll_v1 records on the guest execution thread
Version and symbol presence do not establish support; every operation/profile needs actual VM/native/official simulation qualification
A ROS1 alias and ROS2 alias are different backend-owned authorities
No placeholder rcl/rclcpp/roscpp headers are installed
